_comment: Checked by its own `npm run typecheck` step, not via project references: tsconfig.app.json is noEmit, so it cannot be a composite reference (TS6305). It is checked at all because it was NOT -- a preview.ts importing a symbol the addon no longer exports typechecked clean, and the failure surfaced only in `build-storybook`, in CI. `files` is explicit because TypeScript skips dot-directories when expanding an `include` glob, so `include: ['.']` silently matched nothing.
